d: Temba Bavuma has given South Africa another reason to believe in their Test cricket team. From ending the country's long wait for an ICC trophy to leading from the front against Australia, the South African captain continues to deliver when the stakes are high. His 179 in the second Test against Australia was central to South Africa's emphatic victory, but what makes Bavuma such an effective leader? Rupha Ramani looks at his captaincy, his approach under pressure and how he has helped shape South Africa's resurgence.
